content: To maximize the benefits of this medication, it is important to use it as directed. Common side effects may include headache, mild stomach or abdominal pain, bloating, redness or pain at the injection site, and breast tenderness or pain. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. However, it may cause a condition called ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS), which can occur during or after treatment. In rare cases, severe OHSS can lead to a sudden buildup of fluid in the stomach, chest, and heart areas. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States or Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) products, or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. This treatment may increase the likelihood of multiple births. Stop using this medication if you become pregnant, as it must not be used during pregnancy. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, your doctor may order lab or medical tests, such as vaginal ultrasounds, hormone level checks, or liver function tests, to monitor your progress. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Store this medication in the refrigerator or at room temperature, away from light. Do not freeze it. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
